weight-scale: A bathroom scale; on hover it is stepped on: its top dips and springs back while the needle swings up, wavers and settles on a reading.
whale: A whale with a lighter belly; on hover it spouts water higher and sways in the swell.
wheelbarrow: A wheelbarrow from the side; on hover its handles lift and it tips up on the wheel.
wheelchair: A wheelchair seen from the side; on hover it rolls forward, its wheel turning.
whisk: A balloon whisk of wire loops gathered into a narrow neck; on hover the wires turn round the handle as it beats.
whistle: A referee's whistle; on hover it is blown: it shakes and sound lines come out of the slot.
whiteboard: A whiteboard on an easel; on hover the line on it is drawn to the end and finished with an arrowhead.
wifi: Signal arcs that fill up from the inside out on hover.
wind: Three gusts that curl at their ends; on hover each one blows through from left to right and comes in again behind itself, one after another.
wind-chime: A wind chime; on hover a breeze sets its tubes swinging, out of step, until they hang still again.
wind-turbine: A wind turbine on its tower; on hover its three blades turn a third of a revolution.
windmill: A tower windmill with four sails; on hover the sails turn half a revolution in the wind.
window-frame: A four-pane window with curtains tied back; the curtains draw shut on hover.
wine: A wine glass; on hover it is tipped by its stem one way and the other while the wine sloshes level in the bowl, then it settles upright.
wink: A winking face; on hover it tips its head and the smile widens.
wireless-charger: A round magnetic charging pad on its cable; on hover a light runs round its magnet ring and the charge bolt pulses.
workflow: A start step linked to the next by an elbow; on hover the steps draw apart along the link.
wrap-text: Lines of text whose middle line curls round onto the next; on hover the margin moves in and the lines wrap sooner.
wrench: An open-end wrench; on hover it turns about the nut held in its jaw.
wristwatch: An analog wristwatch on its strap; on hover the hands run forward.
x-ray: A chest film in a light box, ribs and spine in white; on hover a band of light passes down the film.
yo-yo: Two discs on an axle seen at an angle, the string rising from between them to a finger loop; on hover it runs down the string and climbs back.
yoga-mat: A rolled yoga mat; on hover it unrolls along the floor, the roll turning as it goes.
zoom-in: A magnifier with a plus; on hover the lens grows and so does the plus.
zoom-out: A magnifier with a minus; on hover the lens draws back and the minus shortens.
